definition.note: Revolution of a line secant to an axis about that axis; the special case of the elliptic cone (whose record already resolves ch1235) with circular cross-section.

provenance.definition: Classical closed form, written directly in the exact language and checked by the validator.
sources: R. Ferreol, "Cone of revolution", Encyclopedie des formes mathematiques remarquables, mathcurve.com; local mirror chapter ch1229_conederevolution_2 (S:/data/math_art/references/websites/mathcurve/book/surfaces/ch1229_conederevolution_2.md).

caveats: The a = b special case of the elliptic cone, which is exactly what mesh.quadric_add's ELLIPTIC_CONE builds at its defaults (both semi-axes 1): revolution of a line secant to an axis about that axis.
